description: Search Google News for `<query>` — returns headline, source, link, date, and snippet via SerpApi. Example: serpapi_google_news({ q: "openai", gl: "us", hl: "en", _apiKey: "your-serpapi-key" })

_apiKey.description: SerpApi API key (get one at serpapi.com)

hl.description: Optional two-letter UI language code, e.g. "en", "fr"

q.description: News search query, e.g. "openai", "federal reserve rate"

name: serpapi_google_news
